stage: Complete the pure-image query/reference cross, freeze image selection, then evaluate the previously validated OCR repairs.
deduplication: Original SHA groups and stable row-order ties, unchanged.
human_region_policy: ../manual_box_audit corrected crops; reviewed human boxes only. Five superseded crops are replaced. SAM prohibited.
reuse: Reuse all encoded features and original-query score arrays; compute missing cropped-query versus new-reference scores. No repeated OCR recognition or model encoding.

image_selection.scope: Freeze selected family and both weights using only the existing validation identities, before OCR combination. Report the prior fixed composition separately. No per-query oracle or test selection.

ocr_joint.primary_normalization: Fresh per-query z score of full-gallery image scores and OCR scores.
ocr_joint.calibration_control: Use original image score mean/std for changed image branch, keeping OCR normalization unchanged.
ocr_joint.primary_contrast: 2x2 original/repaired image and original/corrected OCR at fixed0.5. Numeric tokenization is an exploratory comparator and cannot replace the primary corrected OCR based on test results.
ocr_joint.secondary_selection: For the already frozen image branch and corrected OCR only: validation macroTop1, macroMRR, then smaller OCR weight. Keep the fixed0.5 primary result.

evidence: Independent full-gallery ranks and FP64 score checks
Pure-image repair/harm overlaps and candidate switches
Fixed-pair and actual-winner image/OCR margin decomposition
OCR term/line contributions for changed and remaining failures; no truth-selected words used for retrieval
Original247 failures and870 successes; all1117, scene and fixed identity splits
Package-cluster confidence intervals for paired differences
report: Update ../../release/REPORT.html only after a byte-identical backup. Preserve image-based query/reference browsing and clearly mark older results as historical. No separate report page.
limits: Human boxes are diagnostic supervision, not automatic subject detection.
Existing test examples have already been examined; results are exploratory, not a fresh blind test.
Reference current_base differs from the historical cache and is retained as the within-runtime causal comparator.
Operational score decomposition and observed interventions do not uniquely establish absence of identity information in the encoder.
